text:
Renee: Heads-up 1 NimbleHealth onboarding is stuck when they try to invite teammates. Their SSO provider sends email in the `sub` claim and our onboarding treats `sub` as a stable user id -> duplicate accounts created and invite fails. Support ticket SUP-10111 opened. Customer has a renewal check-in in 5 days, flagging as high priority.
Omar: can you paste the error we show and the user-facing message?
Renee: UI shows: "Invite failed: account already exists". Logs: 
```
2026-03-29T09:12:03Z WARN account.create duplicate detected by external_id=sub:alice%40example.com
2026-03-29T09:12:03Z ERROR invite aborted reason=duplicate_account
```
Sasha: hmm we changed claim parsing last month to prefer `sub` for idempotency. Some providers put email into sub and also send `email` claim. Our merge logic expects a stable non-email sub.
Kurt: can we enable a tenant-level compatibility rule to fallback to `email` if `sub` looks like an email? Quick mitigation while we push a safer parser.
Renee: customer reported 12 failed invites across 3 admins. Theyre paused onboarding and worried about seat counts for renewal.
Omar: timeline? If we can unblock today that helps with renewal.
Sasha: I can add a compatibility rule identity.alias_dedupe for tenant=nimblehealth for 48h to treat email-like subs as aliases and dedupe on email. I'll also add audit entries and a rollback.
AlertBot: feature.toggle.identity_alias_dedupe set=true for tenant=nimblehealth (by Sasha)
Sasha: toggle applied. Can support ask them to retry invites?
Renee: they retried and 11/12 invites succeeded, one failed due to different email typo. Customer unblocked and can continue setup. :white_check_mark:
Omar: drafting comms now. Keep it brief and non-technical: apology, we applied a temporary change to allow invites to complete, permanent fix coming, offer 20% credit for onboarding month, and offer a 30-min enablement session. Post draft below for review.
Omar: "Hi Marco 1 thanks for your patience. Were sorry for the onboarding disruption. We applied a temporary change to allow invites to finish while our engineers deploy a permanent fix. We expect the fix to be live tomorrow and will follow up once complete. Wed also like to offer a 20% credit for this billing period and can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough to finish setup. 1 Omar, Customer Success"
Kurt: LGTM. Recommend removing any internal flag mention before sending. Finance ok with 20% credit?
Omar: Finance approved in thread.
Sasha: Plan: release safer claim-parser that validates `sub` format and falls back to `email` when appropriate; add unit tests and an integration test with SSO providers that put email in sub. ETA 2026-03-30 08:30 PT. Ill own release and rollback.
Renee: I added SUP-10111 link to the walkthrough invite and sent calendar invite to Marco + their IT contact.
Omar: Customer replied: "Thanks  we can continue. Please confirm when fix is live and well join the walkthrough."
Sasha: will post release notes after deploy and flip identity_alias_dedupe=false once verified.
Renee: closing support ticket as workaround validated. Account health: at-risk -> improving. Noting renewal as "priority outreach" until post-deploy confirmation.
Omar: tracking checklist: 1) Release claim-parser fix (Sasha) ETA 2026-03-30 08:30 PT, 2) Rollback compatibility flag after verification (Sasha), 3) Post-deploy follow-up email (Omar), 4) Enablement walkthrough (Renee). Thanks team :pray:
